name: Izumi (Miyagi, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Izumi city emblem in white: a stylised bird with outstretched pointed wings.
history: Flag of the former city of Izumi in Miyagi Prefecture, dissolved on 1988-03-01. The flag was adopted in October 1977; the emblem dates from 23 June 1972.

features.role: Izumi city emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched pointed wings
